meta.title: AQA GCSE English Language Mock Paper Bank
meta.subtitle: Original AQA-style GCSE English Language practice papers with secure OpenAI-assisted marking
notes: All sources, extracts and questions are original mock materials and are not official AQA papers.
Each generated paper contains four questions worth 4, 8, 20 and 40 marks and is designed for 1 hour 25 minutes.
The browser saves the selected paper pack and student responses locally on that device.

questions.instructionsTop: You now need to refer only to Source A from lines 1 to the end.
questions.questionText: How does the writer use language and structure in Source A to present the pressure students feel outside school?
bulletPoints: You could write about the writer's tone and viewpoint
You could write about language features and structural choices
You could write about how the writer shapes the reader's response

rubric.name: AO3 analysis of viewpoint
rubric.notes: Reward analysis of how the writer uses methods to present ideas and influence the reader.
